title: A QA task ledger merges its case packages by criterion
description: Manual public RPC proof from a copied artifact-only QA receipt with more than one case package. FARMSLOT_QA_OUTPUT_PROOF_INPUT supplies runSnapshot, taskDir and repo. Originals remain read-only. Rebuilds the copied ledger through recipe-cli's task transport, then gates it on a disposable gateway with a real native worker and a teardown barrier after gate and QA validation.

merged-ledger.intent: Merge the case packages into one ledger by criterion, read it back through task.progress, and pass QA completion with each criterion bound to its case package.

single-execution-binding.intent: Negative control: with every criterion bound to the last case's execution, QA completion refuses the merged ledger as structurally invalid.
